title: Finish Compose Algorithm Window Apps
description: Refactor compose algorithms to use elements/ui UI with AlgorithmApp and compose UI for window kinds. WindowKinds: VecInput, PiecesSelectionInput (Diagram with piece selection, no diff), DesignDiffOutput (Diagram with diff, no selection), DesignOutput (Diagram with no diff, no selection). Remove DESIGN_INPUT. Update all algorithm stories (Drag, Delete, Move, Flatten, Cluster) to use the correct window kinds.
summary: Finished the algorithm window app contract cleanup by codifying the canonical WindowKind behaviors in compose/ui, adding regression coverage for the AlgorithmApp window mapping and default layout, and fixing the shared Vitest wiring so elements/ui, compose/ui, compose/algorithms, and compose/js tests run from real source files. Also constrained compose/js and sketchpad test blocks so they do not execute as import side effects under unrelated Vitest runs, and adjusted the affected inline tests to match runtime diff expectations.
